label: Outcomes
description: Outcomes dataflow alone cannot state. `refuse` ends the graph on purpose: the branch a decision routed here is a declared refusal, not a bug.

refuse.description: Refuse: the graph fails on purpose with message, {{templates}} in it reading what any value may. Answers nothing, but declares a type so it can stand as an out.from candidate opposite the node that answers. A rehearsal reports it as refused on purpose.

message.description: what is said to the caller

type.description: the type the answering candidate has
